newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Origin says replacing chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Origin says replacing chief executive.

text.p: Dutch computer services group Origin BV said on Thursday that it decided to terminate its relationship with Chief Executive Officer Geoffrey Carroll and replace him with former Chief Operating Officer Tom Butler.
Origin, 82 percent owned by Philips Electronics NV, hired both men from Electronic Data Systems Europe in June this year.

"Origin's supervisory board has decided not to continue the relationship with Mr Carroll. Effective today, Mr Butler will assume the responsibility of C.E.O," the company said in a statement. It gave no explanation for the change.

Origin, created earlier this year by a merger between BSO/Origin and Philips-owned Philips Communications and Processing Services said it was now one of the top 10 information technology service providers in the world.
